newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Finance limit down on loan talk.
newsitem.headline: National Finance limit down on loan talk.

text.p: Shares of National Finance and Securities, one of Thailand's leading brokers and financiers, fell 6.0 baht on market talk over the quality of its loan portfolio.
Brokers said the stock, which fell the daily maximum of 10 percent to 54 baht, was hit by speculation surrounding possible bad debts to local property firms.
"They are down on their property links, but I don't think their exposure is higher than other firms," said an analyst.

National Finance's Vice-President of Corporate Affairs Apichart Intravisit said the company had no explanation for the drop. He said 18 percent of the company's lending was to property companies but added that all loans were fully collateralized.
